storyCards.headline: Just A Gigolo I Ain't Got Nobody: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
David Lee Roth's "Just A Gigolo I Ain't Got Nobody" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Just A Gigolo I Ain't Got Nobody was released in 1985.

Chart story — peaked at #12 on the Hot 100.
